'''Repulsorcarts''', a '''repulsor cart''', or '''hovercarts''', were a type of [[repulsorlift]] vehicle used around the [[the galaxy]] to carry cargo.

==Description==
Repulsorcarts also referred to as hovercarts were a [[repulsorlift]] vehicle used to transport cargo.<ref name="LotJ" /> They could be pulled by animals or [[pilot]]ed by a [[droid]].<ref name="Streets of Mos Espa">{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Skywalker_with_kyber_crystal.png|thumb|205x205px|A Hovercart on Utapau]]
During the [[High Republic Era]], when the [[Blythe family]] of [[Elphrona]] was [[Raid on Elphrona|kidnapped]] by [[Nihil]] [[pirate]]s, the destruction of the pirates' [[landspeeder]] in the initial attack forced them to steal the Blythes' repulsorcart and five [[steelee]]s as transportation. Two of the creatures were employed to pull the cart.<ref name="LotJ" />

During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Sugi]] [[arms dealer]]s used hovercarts on [[Utapau]], and [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] stole one to transport a massive [[Kyber crystal]] across the [[planet]]'s plains.<ref name="Crystal Crisis">{{TCW|Crystal Crisis}}</ref>

During the [[Gorse Conflict]], The former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] used a hovercart to unload a shipment of [[baradium-357]] from his freighter [[Moonglow-72|''Expedient'']] on the [[moon]] [[Cynda]] . He used the same hovercart to evacuate the wounded miner [[Yelkin]] after discovering an illegal test bomb in [[Zone Forty-Two]]. Using his [[The Force|Force]] powers, Kanan managed to push Yelkin to safety on the hovercart and cushioned the hovercart's landing. Later, Kanan and his rebel companions [[Hera Syndulla]], [[Skelly]], and [[Zaluna Myder]] used a hovercraft to travel through [[Count]] [[Denetrius Vidian]]'s headquarters, the [[Calcoraan Depot]], to reach his personal quarters.<ref name="New Dawn">[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']]</ref>

By [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Outlaws Date">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> repulsor carts were used around the the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] including on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] and the [[savanna]] [[moon]] [[Toshara]].<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Book of Boba Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> [[Major]] [[Mok Shaiz]]'s [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|majordomo]] fled from the [[crime lord]] [[Boba Fett]] in [[Mok Shaiz's luxury speeder|landspeeder]] through the streets of Tatooine's [[city]] [[Mos Espa]]. During the chase, the [[majordomo]] knocked over a repulsorcart being drawn by an [[astromech droid]].<ref name="Streets of Mos Espa" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Repulsorcarts appeared in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the novel [[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Hope'']], written by [[John Jackson Miller]]<ref name="New Dawn" /> and released on [[September 2]], [[2014]]<ref name="New Dawn Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/240647/a-new-dawn-star-wars-by-john-jackson-miller|text=A New Dawn: Star Wars|oldversion=20150518052209}}</ref> They were first pictured in "[[Crystal Crisis]]", an unfinished episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series<ref name="Crystal Crisis" /> released on [[Wikipedia:Youtube|Youtube]] on [[September 25]], 2014<ref name="Clone Wars Legacy YouTube">{{SWYouTube|vnH1JKr4o_8|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Legacy|sw_url=video/the-clone-wars-legacy}}</ref>
